name: lazy-eng-study-codex
description: Lazy English study for Codex with Korean translation and English correction.

interface.shortDescription: Study English while using Codex through translation and correction.
interface.longDescription: Lazy Eng Study Codex translates Korean prompts and corrects English requests. Auto mode discovers the oldest GPT generation currently available in Codex with medium reasoning, so retired model versions require no manual model update. Use $kortoeng-model auto to enable it on an existing installation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me configure lazy English study in Codex with automatic supported-model discovery and medium reasoning.
